name: CundallStrackAdhesivePotential
description: CundallStrack model with adhesive part. Contact is created when $u/a-\varepsilon < 0$ and released when $u/a-\varepsilon > l_{adh}$, where $l_{adh} = f_{adh}/k_n$. This lead to an hysteretic attractive part.
